_about: How every graph on the screens gets its numbers. Matched in order on the graph title (first match wins). source: live = filled from the model when the page renders; model = calculated from the model by sync_pages.py; scaled = total matches the model, split hand-set; illustrative = shape only, at model scale; layout = not KPI data. Shown on the KPI Reference page (R-01).
